title: Boutique Agency - 40+ Custom Projects in 5 Years
context_pt: Agência boutique própria: posicionamento de marca + arquitetura web para PMEs. Ritmo sustentável de 2 contratos alto valor a cada 3 meses = 40+ projetos entregues em 5 anos. Gestão full-cycle: discovery, design, dev, launch, manutenção.
context_en: Own boutique agency: brand positioning + web architecture for SMBs. Sustainable cadence of 2 high-value contracts every 3 months = 40+ projects delivered in 5 years. Full-cycle management: discovery, design, dev, launch, maintenance.
challenge_pt: PMEs com budget limitado mas expectativas enterprise; escopo creep constante; múltiplos projetos concorrentes; necessidade de processos replicáveis sem burocracia; LGPD compliance em 100% dos projetos.
challenge_en: SMBs with limited budgets but enterprise expectations; constant scope creep; multiple concurrent projects; need for replicable processes without bureaucracy; LGPD compliance in 100% projects.
problem_pt: Falta de padronização gerava retrabalho; onboarding de clientes caótico; cronogramas estourando; compliance legal negligenciado por pressa; dificuldade em escalar além do founder.
problem_en: Lack of standardization caused rework; chaotic client onboarding; timeline overruns; legal compliance neglected due to rush; difficulty scaling beyond founder.
hypotheses_pt: 1) Template de discovery + briefing estruturado reduziria escopo creep. 2) Design system próprio (componentes Figma) aceleraria UI dev. 3) Checklist LGPD automático no onboarding garantiria compliance. 4) PMO leve (Kanban + Gantt simplificado) controlaria múltiplos projetos.
hypotheses_en: 1) Structured discovery template + briefing would reduce scope creep. 2) Own design system (Figma components) would accelerate UI dev. 3) Automated LGPD checklist in onboarding would ensure compliance. 4) Light PMO (Kanban + simplified Gantt) would control concurrent projects.
decisions_pt: Criei: Discovery Canvas (briefing padronizado), Design System AK (Figma components reutilizáveis), LGPD Compliance Kit (políticas, termos, cookie consent prontos), Project Control Dashboard (Notion + planilhas: escopo, budget, timeline, recursos). Processo de 4 fases: Discovery → Design → Dev → Launch com gates de aprovação.
decisions_en: Created: Discovery Canvas (standardized briefing), AK Design System (reusable Figma components), LGPD Compliance Kit (ready policies, terms, cookie consent), Project Control Dashboard (Notion + sheets: scope, budget, timeline, resources). 4-phase process: Discovery → Design → Dev → Launch with approval gates.
tradeoffs_pt: Investimento upfront em templates/systems (tempo não faturável); rigidez inicial no processo assustava alguns clientes 'ágeis'; manutenção do design system consumia tempo; dependência do founder para decisões estratégicas.
tradeoffs_en: Upfront investment in templates/systems (unbillable time); initial process rigidity scared some 'agile' clients; design system maintenance consumed time; founder dependency for strategic decisions.
results_pt: 40+ projetos entregues em 5 anos (2 a cada 3 meses); 100% LGPD compliance; Cronogramas: 85% no prazo; Budget: 90% dentro do acordado; NPS clientes: 9.2/10; Receita recorrente via manutenção/retentores.
results_en: 40+ projects delivered in 5 years (2 every 3 months); 100% LGPD compliance; Timelines: 85% on time; Budget: 90% within agreed; Client NPS: 9.2/10; Recurring revenue via maintenance/retainers.
star_situation_pt: Founder de agência boutique: 40+ projetos em 5 anos para PMEs. Desafio: escalar qualidade sem burocracia, compliance LGPD, múltiplos projetos simultâneos.
star_situation_en: Boutique agency Founder: 40+ projects in 5 years for SMBs. Challenge: scale quality without bureaucracy, LGPD compliance, concurrent projects.
star_task_pt: Criar processos replicáveis (discovery, design, dev, compliance) para entregar consistência em escala de boutique.
star_task_en: Create replicable processes (discovery, design, dev, compliance) for consistent delivery at boutique scale.
star_action_pt: Discovery Canvas + Design System Figma + LGPD Kit + Project Dashboard (Notion). Processo 4 fases com gates. 2 contratos/trimestre sustentável.
star_action_en: Discovery Canvas + Figma Design System + LGPD Kit + Project Dashboard (Notion). 4-phase process with gates. 2 contracts/quarter sustainable.
star_result_pt: 40+ projetos, 100% LGPD, 85% no prazo, 90% budget, NPS 9.2. Receita recorrente via manutenção.
star_result_en: 40+ projects, 100% LGPD, 85% on time, 90% budget, NPS 9.2. Recurring revenue via maintenance.

title: CRO & Chatbots - Lead Gen +250% (8→30/month)
context_pt: Sites corporativos de clientes geravam poucos leads (8/mês). Necessidade de otimizar conversão sem aumentar tráfego pago. Implementação de chatbots + UX flows + landing pages otimizadas.
context_en: Client corporate sites generated few leads (8/month). Need to optimize conversion without increasing paid traffic. Chatbot implementation + UX flows + optimized landing pages.
challenge_pt: Formulários longos e frios; ausência de engajamento em tempo real; visitantes anônimos saindo sem converter; clientes relutantes em 'chatbot robótico'.
challenge_en: Long cold forms; no real-time engagement; anonymous visitors leaving without converting; clients reluctant to 'robotic chatbot'.
problem_pt: Taxa de conversão visitor-to-lead <1%; nenhum ponto de contato inteligente; dependência exclusiva de formulário de contato; perda de leads quentes fora horário comercial.
problem_en: Visitor-to-lead conversion <1%; no intelligent touchpoint; exclusive dependence on contact form; loss of hot leads outside business hours.
hypotheses_pt: 1) Chatbot conversacional (não robótico) com qualifying questions aumentaria engajamento. 2) Landing pages específicas por segmento (ex: construção civil) com value prop clara converteriam mais. 3) Exit-intent + lead magnets (ebooks, calculadoras) capturariam intenção.
hypotheses_en: 1) Conversational (not robotic) chatbot with qualifying questions would increase engagement. 2) Segment-specific landing pages (e.g., construction) with clear value prop would convert more. 3) Exit-intent + lead magnets (ebooks, calculators) would capture intent.
decisions_pt: Chatbots via ManyChat/Botpress com tom humanizado + qualifying (budget, timeline, need). LPs setoriais: construção civil (5 leads/dia), saúde, varejo. Exit-intent popups com lead magnets. A/B test contínuo: headlines, CTAs, form fields. Heatmaps (Hotjar) para identificar fricção.
decisions_en: Chatbots via ManyChat/Botpress with humanized tone + qualifying (budget, timeline, need). Sector LPs: construction (5 leads/day), healthcare, retail. Exit-intent popups with lead magnets. Continuous A/B test: headlines, CTAs, form fields. Heatmaps (Hotjar) for friction identification.
tradeoffs_pt: Chatbot mal configurado = experiência ruim (risco de marca); LPs específicas exigem manutenção de múltiplas páginas; A/B test precisa volume estatístico (tempo); custo de ferramentas (Hotjar, ManyChat) repassado ou absorvido.
tradeoffs_en: Misconfigured chatbot = bad experience (brand risk); specific LPs require maintaining multiple pages; A/B test needs statistical volume (time); tool costs (Hotjar, ManyChat) passed on or absorbed.
results_pt: Leads: 8 → 20-30/mês (+250% a +275%); LPs construção civil: 5 leads qualificados/dia; Chatbot respondia 24/7 qualificando budget/timeline; Taxa conversão visitor-to-lead: ~1% → ~3-4%; Cliente de construção civil fechou R$ 100k+ em contratos via leads do site.
results_en: Leads: 8 → 20-30/month (+250% to +275%); Construction LPs: 5 qualified leads/day; Chatbot 24/7 qualifying budget/timeline; Visitor-to-lead conversion: ~1% → ~3-4%; Construction client closed R$ 100k+ contracts via site leads.
star_situation_pt: Sites de clientes geravam 8 leads/mês. Formulários frios, sem engajamento real-time, conversão <1%.
star_situation_en: Client sites generated 8 leads/month. Cold forms, no real-time engagement, conversion <1%.
star_task_pt: Implementar CRO via chatbots humanizados + LPs setoriais + exit-intent para multiplicar leads sem aumentar tráfego.
star_task_en: Implement CRO via humanized chatbots + sector LPs + exit-intent to multiply leads without increasing traffic.
star_action_pt: Chatbots ManyChat/Botpress (qualifying budget/timeline). LPs setoriais (construção: 5 leads/dia). Exit-intent + lead magnets. A/B test contínuo + heatmaps.
star_action_en: ManyChat/Botpress chatbots (qualifying budget/timeline). Sector LPs (construction: 5 leads/day). Exit-intent + lead magnets. Continuous A/B test + heatmaps.
star_result_pt: Leads 8→30/mês (+250%). Construção: 5 leads/dia. Conversão 1%→4%. Cliente fechou R$ 100k+ via site.
star_result_en: Leads 8→30/month (+250%). Construction: 5 leads/day. Conversion 1%→4%. Client closed R$ 100k+ via site.

title: E-Commerce 0-to-1 - R$ 10k em 3 Meses Orgânico
context_pt: Cliente varejo queria e-commerce do zero. Budget zero para ads. Estratégia: posicionamento estratégico no Instagram + SEO técnico + UX otimizada para conversão.
context_en: Retail client wanted e-commerce from zero. Zero ad budget. Strategy: strategic Instagram positioning + technical SEO + conversion-optimized UX.
challenge_pt: Lançar e-commerce sem budget de mídia paga; construir autoridade de marca do zero; converter visitantes orgânicos em compradores; logística e pagamentos integrados.
challenge_en: Launch e-commerce with zero paid media budget; build brand authority from scratch; convert organic visitors to buyers; integrated logistics and payments.
problem_pt: Nenhuma base de clientes; SEO leva meses; Instagram orgânico exige consistência; carrinho abandonado alto sem remarketing pago; confiança do consumidor em marca nova.
problem_en: No customer base; SEO takes months; organic Instagram requires consistency; high cart abandonment without paid retargeting; consumer trust in new brand.
hypotheses_pt: 1) Posicionamento de nicho no Instagram (conteúdo educativo + lifestyle) atrairia audiência qualificada. 2) SEO técnico desde day 1 (schema, velocidade, mobile) aceleraria indexação. 3) UX checkout simplificado + proof social (reviews, selos) reduziria abandono. 4) Email marketing automatizado (abandono, boas-vindas, pós-venda) recuperaria receita.
hypotheses_en: 1) Niche Instagram positioning (educational + lifestyle content) would attract qualified audience. 2) Technical SEO from day 1 (schema, speed, mobile) would accelerate indexing. 3) Simplified checkout UX + social proof (reviews, badges) would reduce abandonment. 4) Automated email marketing (abandonment, welcome, post-purchase) would recover revenue.
decisions_pt: WordPress + WooCommerce + Elementor. Instagram: 3 posts/semana (educativo, bastidores, produto) + stories diários + UGC. SEO: schema product, core web vitals, blog estratégico. Checkout: 1 página, guest checkout, selos segurança. Email: 5 automações (boas-vindas, abandono 1h/24h, pós-venda, review request).
decisions_en: WordPress + WooCommerce + Elementor. Instagram: 3 posts/week (educational, behind-scenes, product) + daily stories + UGC. SEO: product schema, core web vitals, strategic blog. Checkout: 1-page, guest checkout, security badges. Email: 5 automations (welcome, abandonment 1h/24h, post-purchase, review request).
tradeoffs_pt: Crescimento lento inicial (3 meses para tração); dependência de algoritmo Instagram; SEO resultados pós-3-6 meses; sem ads = sem controle de volume; founder time intenso em conteúdo.
tradeoffs_en: Slow initial growth (3 months traction); Instagram algorithm dependency; SEO results post 3-6 months; no ads = no volume control; intensive founder time on content.
results_pt: R$ 10.000 faturamento nos primeiros 3 meses (100% orgânico, R$ 0 ads); Instagram: base engajada convertendo; SEO: palavras-chave long-tail rankeando; Email: 25% recuperação carrinho abandonado; Modelo validado para replicar em outros clientes.
results_en: R$ 10,000 revenue in first 3 months (100% organic, $0 ads); Instagram: engaged base converting; SEO: long-tail keywords ranking; Email: 25% cart abandonment recovery; Model validated for replication with other clients.
star_situation_pt: Cliente varejo: e-commerce do zero, budget zero ads. Precisava faturar rápido organicamente.
star_situation_en: Retail client: e-commerce from zero, zero ad budget. Needed revenue fast organically.
star_task_pt: Lançar e-commerce 100% orgânico: Instagram estratégico + SEO técnico + checkout otimizado + email automação.
star_task_en: Launch 100% organic e-commerce: strategic Instagram + technical SEO + optimized checkout + email automation.
star_action_pt: WP+WooCommerce+Elementor. Instagram 3x/sem + stories + UGC. SEO schema + core web vitals. Checkout 1-página. 5 automações email. A/B test contínuo.
star_action_en: WP+WooCommerce+Elementor. Instagram 3x/week + stories + UGC. SEO schema + core web vitals. 1-page checkout. 5 email automations. Continuous A/B test.
star_result_pt: R$ 10k em 3 meses (R$ 0 ads). 25% recuperação carrinho. Modelo replicado para outros clientes.
star_result_en: R$ 10k in 3 months ($0 ads). 25% cart recovery. Model replicated for other clients.
